name: 6987-soloeagle3-llama31-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct as the target -- an ungated mirror of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, under the Llama 3.1 Community License; same weights, tokenizer and 128256 vocab. Draft head: jamesliu1/sglang-EAGLE3-Llama-3.1-Instruct-8B.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1 -- a single-GPU shape.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1 -- one request in flight, 10% warmup, 60 requests bounded, 900 s safety cap. The stream count is part of the setup, not a free parameter to walk.
workload: One fixed 19-token code-generation prompt replayed 60 times, single turn, no chat template, shipped as configs/data/fastapi-prompt-60.jsonl; `temperature: 0`, 512-token cap, `ignore_eos: false`, sent to /v1/completions with `stream: false`. A real prompt rather than synthetic filler, which a draft head cannot predict.
purpose: A single-user coding assistant with speculative drafting, answering one short code prompt at a time on one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented or nested block is DROPPED by the flat parser, and the
# engine would then start without something declared here.

# Ungated mirror of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (Llama 3.1 Community License). Same weights,
# same tokenizer, same 128256 vocab the draft head is trained on.
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1

# float16, not the checkpoint's bfloat16: the draft head is a float16 checkpoint.
dtype: float16

# Declared, not defaulted. Do not substitute.
attention-backend: fa3

speculative-algorithm: EAGLE3
speculative-draft-model-path: jamesliu1/sglang-EAGLE3-Llama-3.1-Instruct-8B
speculative-num-steps: 5
speculative-eagle-topk: 16
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 64

mem-fraction-static: 0.7

# A startup bound, not an operating point: without it each launch captures ~30 batch sizes of a
# 64-token verify pass. bs=1 is captured either way -- with a speculative algorithm set the
# capture list starts at range(1, 9).
cuda-graph-max-bs: 8
